answer: Because the timing is entered against the trellis challenge, the orchard audit can replay the horizon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 47 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 212 aliases cost 190 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
